verdict.rationale: Orama is an open-source search library with official JavaScript/TypeScript, Python and Rust SDKs for Orama Cloud, and it can run in runtimes such as Deno, so it can be driven programmatically without a UI. The pack never documents headless or CI automation itself, and the Cloud REST APIs are still private. missing for 10: explicit headless/CI usage docs, a CLI for pipeline automation, public REST APIs/OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The open-source search library. Add fast, relevant search to your own application at no cost.
Orama Cloud officially supports the following SDKs: - JavaScript/TypeScript - Python - Rust
With Deno, you can just use the same CDN URL or use npm specifiers
